items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1972-01-19
items.q: I know them guys... Willigan's, a drummer... I don't know Willigan's first name, but he was a crack drummer.

ctx.x: No, no, it's the Monsieur. That's one band, I know them guys, but I can't at present just think of them guys' names. But I can tell you, one band he had was a good one, was Willigan's, a drummer. Who's that? Willigan's. Willigan's?
